baselineLifecycle.scope: Chromium, real recovery-code ceremony, separate QR target browser and authenticators, normal SDK, real Cloudflare Gateway/D1/Router/A/B Workers. Console admission uses a disposable static authority. Browser assets use local test origins. Live testnet RPC qualifies Wallet-approved key enrollment and a finalized ML-DSA threshold transaction.

baselineOwnerParity.scope: Public SDK, Chromium with separate authenticators, real Cloudflare Gateway/D1/Router/A/B Workers and separate preparers. Browser assets use local test origins. No live-chain or latency claim.

simultaneousSdk.scope: Normal browser SDK against Cloudflare Workers. Two simultaneous wallets. Up to eight requests across four rounds, stopping after a failed pair. Includes automatic UI approval and excludes stock preparation and NEAR enrollment. This sample establishes no percentile or long-term capacity claim.

candidateLifecycle.scope: Chromium, real recovery-code ceremony, separate QR target browser and authenticators, normal SDK, real Cloudflare Gateway/D1/Router/A/B Workers. Console admission uses a disposable static authority. Browser assets use local test origins. Live testnet RPC qualifies Wallet-approved key enrollment and a finalized ML-DSA threshold transaction.

coldCreation.scope: Normal Signing keys settings against Cloudflare. This case never calls the private preparation fixture. Backend stock may already exist; Worker traces determine whether preparation was cold.

coldCreationBaseline.failure: Publication did not complete within 300000 ms. The authenticated claim path returned unavailable without starting generic preparation.

capacity.scope: Cloudflare durable test drivers call the ordinary forwarding Router through a service binding. One outstanding demand per wallet and the separately recorded offered-demand interval. Backpressure reduces the actual demand rate. Failed-operation retries can create additional operation IDs within one demand. Signatures independently verified by Node/OpenSSL after collection. Client network, SDK, login, UI and NEAR finality are excluded. Initial stock must be excluded from refill throughput.
capacity.restoration_boundary: External observer starts before the load ends, waits for complete drivers and no live Preparing/Running authority for unresolved operations, then reads exact matching sixteen-pair A/B reserves with no reservations or pending refill leases. Captured active producer completion tails extend the cycle boundary when later. Non-admitted AwaitingStock requests remain censored. Observed completion is an upper bound through the final HTTP replies.
capacity.operation_timing_boundary: First request for the same operation ID through receipt of its verified signature, including unavailable responses.
capacity.cpu_scope: Captured CPU counts invocations starting inside the phase, including inactive-wallet maintenance. Earlier overlapping invocations are counted separately, without a total-compute claim. Active-wallet publication accounting excludes other wallet keys.

routingRollout.scope: Actual persisted groups and versioned initial allocation windows. Directory events lack a parent request ID; temporal inclusion alone does not establish exact invocation parenting. Preserve immutable assignments. Verify effective directory rollout before testing a fresh balanced cohort.

refill_backoff.scope: Transactional admission and separate participant start markers; no cryptographic preparation or hosted latency claim.

refill_fairness.scope: SQLite lifecycle E2E with trusted fixture activations and simulated clocks. Worker E2Es separately verify real private preparation and signatures.

durableLifecycle.scope: Transactional lifecycle and encrypted storage E2E. Synthetic prepared bytes. Real threshold persistence is covered by the investigation harness. No hosted latency claim.

localWorkerLifecycle.scope: Authenticated private Gateway request through real Worker key generation, durable two-role installation, initial signing stock, and client custody verification. Public login and SDK UI are outside this campaign. The additional Gateway campaign uses fresh WebAuthn verification and D1 publication for an existing wallet.

packages.scope: Existing real npm pack/install/entry smoke. Only retains exact tarballs and this public receipt before normal consumer cleanup.

infrastructureRetry.providerMessage: Internal authentication error: internal server error
infrastructureRetry.action: Retry the same code and approved destination; retain the failed API response. No credential bytes changed.

publicEvidenceCredentialAudit.scope: Exact private authentication and role-storage credential values, including private JWK scalars, are absent from the selected public files. This scan is supplementary to the fixed public artifact allowlist.

limits: Baseline capacity used the earlier production build. The final cold-preparation correction has a separate hosted lifecycle repeat.
Capacity timings exclude the browser, public Gateway, SDK, authentication and NEAR finality. Whole-cycle throughput includes reserve restoration.
The eight-wallet cohort is distributed 5/3. Its strict balanced scaling qualifier fails. This is a growing-cohort observation, not a proportional scaling result.
Initial stock does not fully cover every six-minute measurement window. Complete material ledgers account for all disappearance; expiry alone does not prove retirement cause.
Short idle return does not qualify one-hour expiry behavior. Idle maintenance work remains in the measured cost.
Candidate exhaustion still surfaces as a generic SDK error. The capacity driver can create a fresh operation within one demand; this is separate from the public SDK path.
Canonical FIPS seed/key export and standard signatures do not establish a complete protocol composition proof, FIPS signing-algorithm conformance, or FIPS module validation.
Earlier quiet-producer resources are outside this cleanup approval.
